capabilities: Serve an authenticated HTTPS REST API
Expose a built-in MCP server for AI agents
Read, write, patch, move, copy, and delete vault files
Stream vault events and execute Obsidian commands
extras: Runs a local HTTPS server with a self-signed certificate authority; access to Obsidian's configuration directory is blocked by default. Includes a built-in MCP server and an extension API for other plugins.
motivation: Inspired by Vinzent03's advanced-uri plugin, with the goal of expanding automation options beyond the constraints of custom URL schemes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in authenticated interface for external scripts, browser extensions, or AI agents to read and modify vault notes.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Vinzent03's advanced-uri plugin, with the goal of expanding automation options beyond the constraints of custom URL schemes.
Claude Code has native HTTP MCP support.
Cursor supports the Streamable HTTP MCP transport.
Periodic Notes: Adds support for periodic notes

summary: Secure local REST API and MCP server that lets scripts, browser extensions, and AI agents read, write, search, and patch vault notes.
